newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Israeli leaders sign agreement with PLO head Yasser Arafat on a partial withdrawal of Israeli troops from the city of Hebron.
-- Thomson Multimedia considers closing German TV-set manufacturing plant as part of its restructuring program.

-- Markets expect Bank of France monetary policy council to cut rates on Thursday. Tomorrow's meeting, the first after the appointment of two new council members, is seen as a test of the new balance of power on the Bank's monetary policy council.
-- EDF utility to compensate Spain for breaking an electricity supply agreement due to environmentalist lobbying. Spain expects some 12 billion francs, while EDF says will pay 1.3 billion francs.

-- Company heads reluctant to believe in economic pickup in spite of hope that international economic situation and exports may support activity in 1997. Consumer spending and investment are forecast to remain sluggish.
